liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls the China Cat into Rider the best ever, praising powerful energy from the drummers, Garcia and Mydland; Reviewer finds the China Cat into Rider really nice [10][11][15]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the second-set Peggy-O and a thoughtful Far From Me [10]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer finds Jack Straw hard on the ears; a long jam begins around 3:15 [12]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Reviewer always loved an Uncle John's Band or Lazy Lightning, but disliked the CC Rider, Peggy-O and Far From Me choices [18]
- Garcia plays torrents of fast notes at a feverish pace, which the reviewer likens to 2/17/79 [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd80-07-01 t01 Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t03 Franklin's Tower**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t04 El Paso**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t05 Tennessee Jed**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t06 Lazy Lightning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t07 Supplication**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]
- **gd80-07-01 t08 Althea**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-07-01.141396.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 181 min [1]
- **gd80-07-01.sbd.cole.9361.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 15 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard sounds great; Sound is dim and needs full volume; Supplication has an apparent splice near 2:18 where Weir skips his shout; Reviewer calls the soundboard sound fantastic [11][12][15]
- **gd1980-07-01.139309.sbd.moore.berger.flac24**: soundboard; 24 songs; 172 min [2]
- **gd1980-07-01.139308.sbd.moore.berger.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 172 min [3]

## Around the show

- Police were out in force busting people in the parking lot for selling shirts and smoking pot [18]
- Security made the audience stay seated for much of the show [18]
- Women sat on couches on stage and danced during the double encore [19]
- Reviewer says the crowd only broke loose during Wharf Rat [19]
- Reviewer calls it their favorite of 1980, apart from Long Beach in December; they had taped the previous show at UCLA [8]
- Reviewer finds the China-Rider powerful but ranks MSG 3/9/81 as the best modern China Rider [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-07-01.141396.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassettes > ?? > Reel to Reel > PCM; Transfer Info: PCM (Sony SL-10)> Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam… [1]. Also: An audience source (shnid 136754) supplies a 1:02 patch in Supplication and a 5:02 patch around Lost Sailor [1]
- **gd80-07-01.sbd.cole.9361.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Reviewer's analog copy comes from a master by Ron Elner; they say they did not tape this show themselves; The second-set cassette circulating is a higher generation than the first-set cassette; Reviewer first got the second set of this show from GDLive, as their first taste of live Dead [8][10][17]
- **gd1980-07-01.139309.sbd.moore.berger.flac24**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: sbd; Jerry Moore’s 2nd gen cassettes; maxell udxlII90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96; transfer & seeded by Rob Berger [2]
- **gd1980-07-01.139308.sbd.moore.berger.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: sbd; Jerry Moore’s 2nd gen cassettes; maxell udxlII90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96; transfer & seeded by Rob Berger [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead San Diego Sports Arena - July 1, 1980](https://www.dead.net/show/july-1-1980) [21]
